question: restaurants inside buildings
sql: SELECT p.names.primary AS restaurant, b.id AS building_id, b.height FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Within(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant' LIMIT 10;

question: buildings containing restaurants
sql: SELECT b.id, b.height, p.names.primary AS restaurant FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Contains(b.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant' LIMIT 10;

question: buildings touching other buildings
sql: SELECT a.id AS building_a, b.id AS building_b FROM lisbon_buildings a JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Touches(a.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE a.id < b.id LIMIT 10;

question: POIs intersecting building footprints
sql: SELECT p.names.primary AS poi, p.basic_category, b.id AS building_id FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10;

question: school buildings containing places
sql: SELECT b.id, b.class, p.names.primary AS place FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Contains(b.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE b.class = 'school' LIMIT 10;

question: residential buildings intersecting restaurants
sql: SELECT b.id, b.subtype, p.names.primary AS restaurant FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Intersects(b.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE b.subtype = 'residential' AND p.basic_category = 'restaurant' LIMIT 10;
